paragraphs: Paradox Engineering designs Internet of Things solutions that cities use to control and monitor street lighting. Energy efficiency, installation and maintenance cost, and cybersecurity are the problems the product pages put in front of cities and utilities. Interoperability and multi-vendor systems are offered as a counter to relying on one single vendor.

Established in 2005 and headquartered in Switzerland, the company started in industrial data transportation before extending that model to urban applications. Since 2015 it has been part of the Japanese Group MinebeaMitsumi, which the same page ties to development of Smart Lighting and Smart City solutions. A quality policy states the objective of growing as MinebeaMitsumi Group's IoT excellence centre, and the pages record ISO 9001:2015 certification.

quote.text: We make cities thrive on lighting.
